amendments.cause: data/edgelab/observations yesBid/yesAsk switch from cents to dollars inside 2026-09-10 (all runs from 2026-09-11 are dollars); build divided every row by 100
amendments.fix: unit decided per ingest run (provenance.sourceFile, runId): any bid/ask > 1.0 in the run -> cents, else dollars; registry files likewise per file. Contract inclusion unchanged except 4 contracts (11,593 both before/after; drop counts differ by <=9)

amendments.symptom: CONFIRM mid Brier 0.47 / log loss 2.5; CONFIRM quotes like yes_bid 0.0055
amendments.type: data-format bug fix (no change to any rule, threshold, split or criterion)
